normal_speed_drift.note: No foot lock is claimed at normal speed. With a fixed 40 ms phase clock the planted side foot slides by the listed amount per phase; with the pure distance driver (phase=floor(dist/2) mod 12) the source cycle is footlocked but advances 70 phases/s, so 60 fps playback skips phases. Front/back cycles are in place (not world-locked). No fluidity claim.
